title: fix(rest): one per-caller read gate for GET /meta/:type/:name and every door beside it
body:
Fixes #20156
Clause-②: no

## What this changes

The plain single-item read `GET /meta/:type/:name` applies a per-caller read gate. The read doors beside it served the same stored document with none of those gates. Every door now asks **one** function, `RestServer#metaItemReadGate`. The plain read's per-type gates (the app nav filter, the ADR-0057 D10 dashboard widget gate, the ADR-0046 §6.7 docs audience) moved into it unchanged, and the plain read calls it too. A door therefore cannot serve the document past a gate the plain read applies. The census (below) reads its door list off the route table, so a door added later without a declared disposition fails.

#20130 (the `app` row of this family) was closed as a duplicate of this card by triage; its app measurements and its owed runtime-dispatcher reading are covered here.

### What each door answers now, by the kind of body it serves

| door | serves | answers |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `/published` | one document, the representation the plain read serves | exactly the plain read's answer: same refusal, or the same pruned / masked document (every gate arm) |
| `/layers`, `?layers=true` | the stored layers, side by side | the plain read's refusal where it refuses; **`403 PERMISSION_DENIED` where the plain read would serve part of an app**; the ADR-0106 object mask as before; per-deployment gates not applied |
| `/diff` | two stored versions compared | as the layered view, judging the current document **and both sides**; object `fields` values masked; a gated type with nothing behind the name answers the plain read's `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` |
| `/history`, `/audit` | events, never a body | the plain read's refusal where it refuses the item whole; otherwise the events |
| `/references` | identities of OTHER items that point at this one | declared exempt: no member of this item's document is served |

### Two deliberate departures from the dispatch's suggested route, both measured

1. **A stored-version door refuses a partly-withheld app instead of serving it pruned.** `content/docs/plugins/adding-a-metadata-type.mdx` documents that Studio's `DesignerEditorWrapper` loads the layered view via `?layers=true` and saves what it loaded, and `PUT /meta/:type/:name` persists the body it is handed. A pruned app loaded there and saved back would delete the entries withheld from that author, and nothing in the exchange would say so. The census rule allows "or refuses", and refusing is loud where pruning is silent. The object mask stays a projection on those doors because ADR-0106 D4 exempts every caller who may write a schema, so a masked version never reaches a writer. The app nav filter has no such exemption. See the open question in the report.
2. **The dashboard widget gate is not a per-caller gate** (Zone 2 assumption falsified at source). It asks which optional services this deployment registered and answers every caller alike. The plain read's own cache-exclusion comment says so. Applying it on the stored-version doors would make the designer load, and save back, a dashboard minus a widget whose service is merely off here. `/published` keeps it, as it answers what the plain read answers. The app's `requiresService` and servability arms get the same split. `content/docs/ui/apps.mdx` gains one paragraph stating this.

### A fifth gated type the doors skipped: `object`

The plain read also applies the ADR-0106 object-schema mask. `/layers` already applied it; `/published` and `/diff` did not. ADR-0106 D5(4) prescribes routing such an outlet through the same projection, so both now mask: `/published` masks the document, and `/diff` masks the `fields` values in every bucket, on both sides. This follows the redaction precedent one frame down: bodies are compared raw and the emitted values are projected.

## Red before, green after

Census: `packages/rest/src/meta-alternate-door-read-gates.test.ts`. It covers gated type (`doc`, `book`, `app` ×3 including permission-gated and unpublished, `dashboard`, `object`, plus a `view` control) × door (`?layers=true`, `/layers`, `/published`, `/diff`, `/history`, `/audit`) × caller (reader, non-reader, anonymous). Every cell asserts the door's status + code equals the plain read's for that caller, or the declared refusal, and that the secret markers are absent (or present, for a reader). The plain-read rows are themselves asserted against the census table, with a cached protocol method present, so a gated type missing from the cache exclusion reddens too.

- **Before the fix** (at `db4de902`, test file only): 190 cases, **35 red**. Red cells: `doc` non-reader on all six doors; `book` non-reader on all six; `app` `crm` non-reader on `/layers`, `?layers=true`, `/published`, `/diff`; `app` `payroll` and `launchpad` non-reader on all six; `dashboard` on `/published`; `object` non-reader on `/published` and `/diff`. Plus **anonymous × `?layers=true` × `doc` and `book`: 200 with the body**, including the `org`-audience doc the plain read answers `401` (that door sits on the route anonymous callers may reach for public docs).
- **After** (at `ace7e1df`): 194 cases (four edge pins added: per-layer judging, a gate-input fault on the stored-version doors answering the fault rather than a 403, an absent gated item, and no extra read for ungated types), **0 red**.

**Ablation** (committed fix first, mutation via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): replaced the `/published` door's `metaItemReadGate` call with an ungated serve. Anchor 1 → 0, blob `524c67ca` → `5a8bfcbd`. The `/published` census row went **7 red**: every gated cell of that door. The `object` cell stayed green because the mask is its own seam, which is correct. Restore: blob after `524c67ca` == HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty. The subject is imported from source (`./rest-server.js`, relative), so no `dist/` was involved.

## Verification (all at `ace7e1df`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --project local`: 197 files, **3518 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed**.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck` (tsc plus `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- `pnpm lint` (repo-wide `eslint . --no-inline-config`): exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` derived 90 families from merge base `9347c1f2`. Run and reconciled with `--ran`: **88 exit 0, 2 NOT MEASURED** (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:type-check-debt`), both PREREQUISITE NOT MET on full-farm builds that CI performs. `check:skill-examples` first refused on unbuilt `client`/`client-react`; built them and it read exit 0.
- `execctx-consumer-census.test.ts` re-measured: 69 → 70 `resolveExecCtx` sites, 92 → 93 mentions, all caught with `rethrowAuthzStoreUnavailable`. Two sites moved into the gate and one is new, for the current-document fetch.

## Changeset

`.changeset/20156-alternate-door-read-gates.md`, **patch** for `@objectstack/rest`: a security fix in a released package with no authorable surface removed (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3). It states who could read what before, and what each door answers now.

## Acceptance notes

- **Runtime dispatcher (`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`, `handleMetadataRequest`) was measured and deliberately left unchanged.** Driven in-process with an authenticated non-holder, it answers `GET /meta/doc/NAME`, `/meta/doc/NAME/published`, `/meta/book/NAME`, `/meta/app/NAME` and `/meta/app/NAME/published` with `200` and the gated body, gated book and `requiredPermissions` entry. The **plain read itself** is ungated on that transport, so there is no plain-read gate there for the doors to be pulled back to. Which hosts reach it: the in-repo reach measurement in `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-verb-fallthrough.test.ts` (driven through a real `createHonoApp`) names catch-all-only hosts, the documented embed shape. Where `RestServer` is mounted, its routes shadow these paths. Gating that transport needs either the gate extracted to a seam both transports call, or the dispatcher's `/meta` item reads retired. A port into `runtime` would be a second audience resolution, which the maintainer ruling recorded on #19790 forbids. Reported to the seat as a finding with that decision attached.
- `/diff` of a `doc`, `book` or `app` whose current document is absent now answers `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` (the plain read's answer). Before, it answered a diff of the deleted item's versions. `/history` and `/audit` of such an item still serve its events, which carry no body.
- A version's per-caller answer is judged against the current document's gate inputs, plus any gate input the diff itself reports on either side. That is exact when `to` is the current version (the default). For an explicit historical `to`, a gate input unchanged between the two versions is judged at its current value.
- `/references` is declared exempt in the census, with its reason. It serves the type, name and label of OTHER items that reference this one, and it applies none of those items' own gates. Not measured here, and outside this card's class.
- #20139 remains open; this PR does not touch the bare `Number()` query reads.
